Yes, a few simple basics usually make the biggest difference for a beginner 🙂 If you want to keep it easy, I would start with:

a first aid kit for small mishaps
a head torch for hands-free light
a water bottle for staying hydrated
Those are practical, easy to use, and useful on almost any first trip. If you want something a bit more complete than the Camping First Aid Kit, the Lifesystems Adventurer First Aid Kit is another good option.
